plugin.name: GTA Chinatown Wars PPSSPP Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows PPSSPP stretch settings. Use a ratio such as 21:9 or 32:9 to override it.
ModernControls.description: Map PSP R/L to RT/LT in the emulator: R accelerates or fires, L brakes or aims. On foot Circle keeps the displaced shoulder action; when driving Cross and Square keep the displaced driving actions. PDA, menu and minigame controls stay native.
GamepadIcons.description: Button prompts show the face buttons and D-pad of the chosen controller. Choose the set that matches the controller you use in PPSSPP; the emulated game cannot detect it. Auto uses Xbox 360 icons, PSP keeps the original icons. L, R, Start and Select keep their PSP artwork.
Enable3rdPersonCamera.description: Switch cameras with D-pad Right and adjust the third-person view with the right stick. The original cinematic camera is disabled. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
RadioInAllVehicles.description: Allow radio playback in emergency vehicles. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading and PDA transitions.
UnlockXinMissionsInReplayBoard.descripti: Experimental replay-board availability override. Does not alter saved mission progress. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logo movie at startup. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HudScale.description: Scale the complete gameplay HUD around screen-edge anchors. PDA applications retain native proportions.
FOVFactor.description: Scales the gameplay field of view from 0.5 to 2.0; 1.0 keeps the original angle, higher values show more of the city. Story scenes keep their own framing.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the gameplay HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). Auto is the default. Presets keep your chosen ratio.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the cinematic bars above and below story scenes. Pillarbox adds side bars on screens wider than the PSP frame. Both combines these modes. Off fills the screen during in-engine shots. Comic panels keep their original proportions.
